  else

done

commands.command:
set -eu
node2_ip=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node2" {print $1; exit}')
printf 'SOURCE_BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'REMOTE_LOGIN='; sudo -n -u opsbot ssh -i /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PreferredAuthentications=publickey -o PasswordAuthentication=[REDACTED]]] -o KbdInteractiveAuthentication=no -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "opsbot@$node2_ip" 'printf "%s@%s remote_boot=" "$(id -un)" "$(hostname)"; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf "proof="; stat -c "%U:%G %a" "$HOME/.opsbot-ssh-proof"'
log=/tmp/opsbot-node2-no-key-post-reboot.log
if sudo -n -u opsbot ssh -F /dev/null -o BatchMode=yes -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PasswordAuthentication=[REDACTED]]] -o KbdInteractiveAuthentication=no -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "opsbot@$node2_ip" true >"$log" 2>&1; then printf 'NO_KEY=UNEXPECTED_SUCCESS\n'; exit 1; else rc=$?; printf 'NO_KEY=REJECTED_RC_%s ' "$rc"; tail -n 1 "$log"; fi

proof=opsbot:opsbot 664
NO_KEY=REJECTED_RC_255 opsbot@10.100.242.11: Permission denied (publickey).

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'SSH_SERVICE='; systemctl is-active ssh
printf 'SSH_SOCKET='; systemctl is-active ssh.socket
printf 'LISTENER='; ss -tln | awk '$4 ~ /:22$/ {print $4; found=1} END {if (!found) exit 1}' | paste -sd, -
printf 'ACCOUNT='; id opsbot
printf 'AUTHORIZED_KEY='; ssh-keygen -lf /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys
printf 'AUTHORIZED_KEYS_MODE='; stat -c '%U:%G %a' /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys
printf 'PROOF_FILE='; stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /home/opsbot/.opsbot-ssh-proof
sudo -n sshd -t
printf 'POLICY='; sudo -n sshd -T -C user=opsbot,host="$NODE_NAME",addr="$NODE_IP" | awk '/^(authenticationmethods|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|pubkeyauthentication) / {printf "%s=%s ",$1,$2} END {print ""}'
